clauses.requirement: Approval marking and other markings for grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps (e.g. the rear lamp combining rear position, stop, reversing lamp and retro-reflector in one housing) shall comply with the provisions of UN R148 para 3.3.5 on their approval marking.

Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number may be affixed; this marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that the conditions of paras 3.3.5.1.1 and 3.3.5.1.2 are met.
The single approval mark of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps shall be visible after their installation.

The single approval mark shall be located such that no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.

The size of the components of a single approval mark on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.

Approval marking arrangements for grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, including all the additional symbols mentioned above, shall be consistent with the examples given in Annex 7 of UN R148.
Modifications of a type of lamp for motor vehicles and their trailers, and extension of approval, shall be handled in accordance with the administrative provisions of UN R148 para 3.4.

Every modification of a type of lamp shall be notified to the Type Approval Authority which approved the type; the Authority may then decide on the follow-up options listed in the subsequent sub-paragraphs.
